lines.text: Never open a package you didn't order.
Thanksgiving night, a box was on my porch.
My name. My address. No sender.
Inside was a phone. Already recording.
The video showed my living room. Tonight.
On the screen, I was asleep on the couch.
Then someone walked in and sat down next to me.

lines.say: The timestamp said eleven fifty-eight P.M.

lines.text: Then the couch behind me creaked.
So never open a package you didn't order.
